prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon preparation with carbohydrate loading and optimal hydration for a 42km race tomorrow

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals 3000+ calories with carbohydrates comprising 60-65% of total calories
Includes at least 4 hydration checkpoints with specific fluid recommendations throughout the day
All meals and snacks are vegetarian and nut-free
Plan is compact and presented in a single-day format with clear meal timing
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring 3000+ calories with emphasis on carbohydrate loading and hydration strategy throughout the day

prompt_inputs.goal: Maximize strength and power gains with proper recovery nutrition around weightlifting training

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 4-5 meals distributed throughout the day with strategic timing around training session
Macronutrient ratios support strength/power goals (higher protein ~1.6-2.2g per kg body weight, moderate-high carbs for training fuel and recovery)
Pre-training and post-training meals are specifically identified with appropriate nutrient composition for performance and recovery
Plan is compact and concise (fits within 1 day format without excessive detail)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) with specific macronutrient ratios, meal timing around training sessions, and recovery nutrition needs

prompt_inputs.goal: Maintain weight class (71 kg limit) while preparing for competition in 3 days, maximizing energy and strength
prompt_inputs.restrictions: Low sodium (under 2000mg daily), no dairy due to lactose intolerance

solution_criteria: Meal plan stays within 71 kg body weight maintenance calories (approximately 2400-2600 kcal)
Total daily sodium does not exceed 2000mg
Includes 4-5 meals distributed throughout the day to maintain energy for training
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport with strict weight class requirements (boxer or wrestler) needing calorie and sodium management while maintaining performance and energy levels
